case.title: Christmas Eve: the partner offers the observed Boxing Day
case.script: His partner answers. Asks what it is about and offers to pay. Says Tomasz is back on Monday and can be called at nine in the morning. When asked for another time, says 'Tuesday, half past five in the afternoon'.
checks: nothing said beyond the opening sentence; no product, amount or reason
Monday 28 December refused: Boxing Day (26 Dec, a Saturday) moves to Monday 28
verify_identity, get_account and add_note never called
